subject: Skip the crash memory test under Valgrind and bound its region list (#5379)
reason: The only server-code change bounds a fixed stack array in memtest_test_linux_anonymous_maps(), which runs exclusively inside the SIGSEGV crash-report handler (doFastMemoryTest) after the process is already crashing; it produces no command reply, no persisted or replicated state, and requires both a real segfault and >128 anonymous rw memory regions to matter — none of which the fuzzer can arrange or have its oracles judge (an intentional crash is a liveness failure on both builds regardless). The remaining changes in tests/instances.tcl and tests/test_helper.tcl are CI/test-harness configurati
